title: Import statement
desc: Upload a screenshot or CSV of your card statement. Review everything before saving.
errorReadingImage: Couldn't reliably read this image. Try another screenshot or fill in manually.
errorReadingPdfRetry: Couldn't read this PDF now. Try again.
errorNoMovements: No transactions found. Try a clearer file or check the document contains entries.
errorPdfTooBig: PDF too large. Try a file smaller than 12 MB.
errorCsvUnknown: Couldn't identify the statement columns. Check the file or adjust the fields manually.
errorPickMonth: Pick the statement month before saving.

source.noCards: Add a card before importing the statement.
source.imagensDesc: Upload 1 to 10 screenshots of the statement.
source.manual: I'd rather fill it in manually
source.privacy: We don't ask for full card number, CVV or password. We only use what helps you.

image.loadingSub: This may take a few seconds.
image.uploadHint: Up to 10 images. JPG, PNG or WEBP.

pdf.loadingSub: This may take a few seconds. We're only extracting statement entries.
pdf.uploadTitle: Click to upload the statement PDF
pdf.uploadHint: Accepts text-selectable or scanned PDFs. Up to 12 MB.
pdf.privacy: We only read date, description, amount and payment method. Data like SSN or card number are ignored.

csv.uploadTitle: Click to upload a CSV file
csv.uploadHint: Accepts CSV with comma, semicolon, BRL or international amounts.
csv.tipBody: If columns aren't recognized automatically, we'll open a quick step for you to indicate what's what.

mapping.intro: Indicate what each column of your file represents. Preview of the first rows below.

review.invoiceForLabel: This statement will be imported to
review.invoiceNote: All entries below go into this statement, even if the purchase date is from another month.
review.confirmDesc: Confirmed expenses will be added to your expense list, Dashboard and the selected card's statement.
review.nothingSavedYet: Nothing is saved until you confirm.

history.title: Imported statements
history.subtitle: Import history. Deleting here only removes the batch entries — manual expenses aren't affected.
history.deleteDesc: You're about to delete the imported statement of <0>{{month}}</0>, with <1>{{count}}</1> entries and total of <2>{{total}}</2>. This won't delete manual expenses.

toast.noneAdded: No new entries added. The items found seem to already be in the app.
toast.doneMixed: Import complete: {{novos}} new, {{dup}} duplicate(s) ignored and {{nao}} item(s) not confirmed.
toast.donePure_one: Import complete. {{count}} purchase added to the app.
toast.donePure_other: Import complete. {{count}} purchases added to the app.
toast.removed_one: Import removed ({{count}} entry). Manual expenses preserved.
toast.removed_other: Import removed ({{count}} entries). Manual expenses preserved.
